content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Payment Intents and Stripe Payment Methods ## slug: payment-intents-stripe-payment-methods ## seoTitle: Payment Intents and Stripe Payment Methods ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ## Prerequisites To use this feature, you must meet the following criteria: * Use on iOS mobile device and a {{variable.Product_Stripe}} payment gateway. * Have Version 2.0.2 of the {{variable.Product_MobilePaymentApp}} and Version 6.42 of the Payments package. ## Overview **What is a Payment Intent record?** A {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}} record is used by {{variable.Product_Stripe}} for its Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) feature, which helps make the payment process more secure. **Purpose of Feature Update:** To change how {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}}s are confirmed by the {{variable.Product_MobilePaymentApp}}. ### Previous Functionality The {{variable.Product_MobilePaymentApp}} confirmed the {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}} before making any calls to {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} to capture the {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}}. Once the {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}} was confirmed, additional updates could no longer be made. That meant, all metadata mapping or customer information needed to be added to the {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}} before it was confirmed. But, the details required are located in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. ### New Functionality The {{variable.Product_MobilePaymentApp}} now confirms the {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}} record is updated with any required metadata mapping and customer info before {{variable.Product_Stripe}} captures the {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}}. The streamlined process also reduces the number of API calls made to {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. ## How It Works ### New Custom Settings The Blackthorn Payments | Mobile Settings custom setting includes the {{variable.CS_MobileSet_ConfirmPayIntents}} (bt_stripe__Confirm_Payment_Intents__c) field, which allows you to change where in the process the {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}} will be confirmed. * To use the new setting and postpone the initial confirmation of intent until additional information is gathered, set {{variable.CS_MobileSet_ConfirmPayIntents}} to “False.” * To revert to the out-of-the-box behavior of immediate intent confirmation, set {{variable.CS_MobileSet_ConfirmPayIntents}} to “True” or leave the field blank. **New Order of Operation:** The {{variable.Product_MobilePaymentApp}} creates the {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}} and updates it with any required metadata mapping and customer information before {{variable.Product_Stripe}} receives it. ### Enter Payment Methods Manually Previously, {{variable.Product_Stripe}} only supported creating {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}}s with the {{variable.Product_MobilePaymentApp}} if the card information was captured by a card reader (versus typing the card numbers manually). Now, the following solution applies when manually typing in a card’s information. Since the payload going to {{variable.Product_Stripe}} includes a Payment Method ID but no Payment Intent ID (which was not created because the card info was typed in), the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} payment intents API will create the new {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}} record. This passes the following information to {{variable.Product_Stripe}}: {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}, customer information, and whether the customer has given consent to save the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} by checking the box in the {{variable.Product_MobilePaymentApp}}. After completing the transaction, the result is newly created {{variable.Object_Transaction}} and {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} records linked to the customer in {{variable.Product_Stripe}} and {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. If the customer checks the box to allow their {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} to be reused, it will also be saved for future use. ### Using a Card Reader After using a card reader to complete a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} on the {{variable.Product_MobilePaymentApp}}, a reference to the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} record will be stored with the captured {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}} in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} and {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. ### Additional Configurations When the {{variable.Product_MobilePaymentApp}} and a card reader are used to complete a payment, and the following custom settings are selected, the {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}}'s information will be updated before an attempt to confirm/capture it. * Blackthorn Payments | Mobile Settings {{variable.CS_MobileSet_ConfirmPayIntents}} field *is not* checked. * Blackthorn Pay - Trigger Settings {{variable.CS_EnableSCA}} field is checked. **Scenario 1: If an {{variable.Object_Account}} or {{variable.Object_Contact}} record is not selected, a new {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} (PGC) will be generated for each {{variable.Object_Transaction}}.** Use the {{variable.Product_MobilePaymentApp}} and card reader to complete a payment when an existing {{variable.Object_Account}} and/or {{variable.Object_Contact}} is not selected. The captured payment in the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account will include the customer ID and the charge/transaction ID. {{variable.Product_Stripe}} will share a message indicating that the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} was set up for future or scheduled payments. The pm_id was also set up for future use. Comparing the values from {{variable.Product_Stripe}} with those on the {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record will show that the {{variable.Field_Transaction_CustomerID}}, {{variable.Field_Transaction_PMID}}, and {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactioID}} match the values in {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. The {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s related {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}}, Customer, and {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} records will be complete and include the IDs from {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. The new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} can now be used to complete a new {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, which will generate a new {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record. **Scenario 2: If a {{variable.Object_Contact}} and/or {{variable.Object_Account}} records are selected, a new {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} (PGC) will be created, if required, and used for subsequent {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s.** Use the {{variable.Product_MobilePaymentApp}} and card reader to complete a payment where an existing {{variable.Object_Account}} and/or {{variable.Object_Contact}} are selected. The captured payment in the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account will include the customer ID and the charge/transaction ID. {{variable.Product_Stripe}} will share a message indicating that the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} was set up for future or scheduled payments. The pm_id was also set up for future use. Comparing the values from {{variable.Product_Stripe}} with those on the {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record will show that the {{variable.Field_Transaction_CustomerID}}, {{variable.Field_Transaction_PMID}}, and {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactioID}} match the values in {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. The {{variable.Object_Transaction}}’s related {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}}, Customer, and {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} records will be complete and include the IDs from {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. The new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} can now be used to complete a new {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. Here’s where things differ from the first scenario. Now, when a user completes a new payment using the same {{variable.Object_Contact}} and/or {{variable.Object_Account}} records, a new PGC record is not created. Instead, the PGC record from the original {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is used. A new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} is generated each time, but it will be linked to the first PGC record created for this specific combination of {{variable.Object_Contact}} and/or {{variable.Object_Account}} records. ## Stored Offline Payment Information {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}’s [SmartStore](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/content/learn/modules/mobile_sdk_offline/mobilesdk_offline_smartstore){target=`_blank`} is a multithreaded, secure solution for offline storage. It manages and stores payment information on mobile devices when they are offline. When a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} occurs, the following information will be stored for each {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} type. ### Cash Payments * **Description:** {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_Description}} * **Amount:** {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} * **Currency:** connection is restored * **Timestamp:** Unix timestamp when record was created * **Gateway:** Payment Gateway ID * **Account Id:** Associated {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} {{variable.Object_Account}} * **ContactId:** Associated {{variable.Object_Contact}} information * **Email:** Email recipient for sending the receipt ### Typed Card Payments * **Description:** **Payment Intent Id:** Offline Id for the {{variable.Object_PaymentIntent}}. The card information is managed by {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. * **Account Id:** Associated {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} {{variable.Object_Account}} * **ContactId:** Associated {{variable.Object_Contact}} information * **Email:** Email recipient for sending the receipt ### ACH Payments * **Description:** {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_Description}} * **Amount:** {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} * **Currency:** {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}} * **Method:** HTTP method for API call once connection is restored * **Path:** Salesforce API endpoint to call once connection is restored * **Timestamp:** Unix timestamp when record was created * **Idempotent UUID:** Unique identifier to prevent duplicate processing * **Gateway:** Payment Gateway ID * **Bank Details** * **Account Holder:** Name on bank account * **Account Number:** Bank account number * **Routing Number:** Bank routing/ABA number * **Holder Type:** Account holder type * **Account Id:** Associated {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} {{variable.Object_Account}} * **ContactId:** Associated {{variable.Object_Contact}} information * **Email:** Email recipient for sending the receipt
